name: Physics and Astronomy
notes: The department page writes PHY / AST / MTH; the registrar catalog uses PHYS / ASTR / MATH, the form used here.
PHYS 141-143 (honors) are encouraged for physics and astronomy majors.
ASTR 111 in the first year and ASTR 142 in the sophomore year are strongly recommended but not required.
PHYS 218 or PHYS 243W are recommended among the six physics/astronomy courses.
MATH 282 or OPT 287 is recommended for the second advanced-mathematics course; only MATH 281 is stated as required.
Computer literacy may also be satisfied by an approved computing project or faculty certification rather than a course - those routes are not modeled.
PHYS 244W is named on the page but was not scheduled in the harvested terms and appears as a flagged stub.

requirementGroups.label: Pre-concentration: calculus sequence
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: One of the following calculus sequences: MTH 161, 162, 164, and 165; MTH 171, 172, 173, and 174

requirementGroups.label: Pre-concentration: introductory physics (3)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Three introductory physics courses: PHY 121 or PHY 141; PHY 122 or PHY 142; PHY 123 or PHY 143

requirementGroups.label: Astronomy and relativity courses (3)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Three of the following: PHY 231: Gravitation and General Relativity; AST 232: The Milkyway Galaxy; AST 233: Astrodynamics; AST 241: Stellar Astrophysics; AST 242: Galaxies & Cosmology; AST 243: Astrophysical Fluid Dynamics; AST 244W: Observational Astronomy; AST 265: Physics of Planetary Interiors

requirementGroups.label: Physics and astronomy courses (6)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Six of the following: PHY 217; PHY 218; PHY 227; PHY 235W; PHY 237; PHY 243W; PHY 244W; PHY 245W; PHY 246; AST 393W: Senior Thesis. PHY 218 or 243W are recommended.

requirementGroups.label: Advanced mathematics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two courses in advanced mathematics: MTH 281: Applied Boundary Value Problems is required

requirementGroups.label: Second advanced mathematics course
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: MTH 282: Introduction to Complex Variables with Applications or OPT 287: Mathematical Methods for Optics and Physics is recommended

requirementGroups.label: Computer literacy
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: The computer literacy requirement can be satisfied by: Taking PHY 256: Computational Physics or Taking CSC 171 or Taking CSC 161 or Completing a computing-based problem approved by the department or Having a faculty member certify computer literacy

upperLevelWriting.label: Upper-level writing within the major
upperLevelWriting.sourceQuote: PHY 235W; PHY 243W; PHY 245W; AST 244W: Observational Astronomy; AST 393W: Senior Thesis
